primary.title: Franklin D. Roosevelt: Public Papers and Addresses
primary.author: Franklin D. Roosevelt
primary.rationale: A comprehensive collection of Roosevelt's public speeches and addresses, offering direct insight into his policies and rhetoric during his presidency. Volumes are often available in digital archives.

primary.title: Fireside Chats
primary.author: Franklin D. Roosevelt
primary.rationale: These radio addresses were a direct communication channel between FDR and the American people, explaining his New Deal policies and addressing national concerns. Transcripts are widely available.

primary.title: The Public Papers and Addresses of Franklin D. Roosevelt
primary.author: Franklin D. Roosevelt
primary.rationale: This multi-volume set is a foundational primary source for understanding FDR's presidency, containing his most significant speeches, messages, and statements. Likely digitized by major archives.

secondary.title: Franklin D. Roosevelt: A Political Life
secondary.author: Robert Dallek
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive and well-regarded biography by a leading FDR scholar, offering in-depth analysis of his political career and presidency.

secondary.title: The New Deal: A Documentary History
secondary.author: David B. Woolner
secondary.rationale: This work provides a documentary history of the New Deal, contextualizing FDR's policies with primary source excerpts and scholarly analysis.

secondary.title: FDR and the American Presidency
secondary.author: Michael Nelson
secondary.rationale: An academic examination of Roosevelt's impact on the American presidency, drawing on extensive research and historical scholarship.

suggestions.notes: The 'Public Papers and Addresses' were published in multiple volumes throughout and after his presidency. The 'Fireside Chats' are a specific subset of his public addresses. Secondary sources selected are from reputable historians and published by major academic presses or are widely cited scholarly works.
